method: Exact pinned upstream source checkout review, existing repository compatibility/evidence, isolated temporary files and SQLite, synthetic real-format data generated with the active runner contracts, mocked cluster reads and external writes, local TLS server. No live cluster reads, scans, deployments, public incidents or Wiki publication.

runtimeTransport.selected: Authenticated HTTPS Kubernetes API GET of named node-agent Pod logs with timestamps, independent source/owner/inventory verification and durable normalized queue/cursor

nativeHTTPFindings.serialization: RuntimeAlerts kubescape.io/v1 with spec.alerts array, processTree and cloudMetadata, for single or bulk paths; differs from stderr field layout
nativeHTTPFindings.authentication: Configurable headers and projected bearer tokenFile reread by apiauth transport for configured host; HTTPS downgrade redirects refused. No durable sender identity comes from event metadata.
nativeHTTPFindings.singleRuleRetry: Explicit 429/503 retries use a process-memory FIFO: 1000 entries, 16 MiB, five-minute retention. Ambiguous network failures are not blindly retried.
nativeHTTPFindings.bulkRetry: Process-memory send queue with configured queue size/retry count/backoff. Full queue or exhausted retries can lose data; no disk persistence or restart-resume cursor.
nativeHTTPFindings.selectionReason: Native HTTP needs separately approved exporter/token configuration and a receiver, plus independent heartbeat/durable loss accounting. Log pull uses existing output with no agent change. Neither upstream transport proves complete detector emission.

runtimeTransport.imageIdentityEvidence: infra/kubescape/runtime/prerequisites.json retains the pinned index and independently qualified amd64 child
runtimeTransport.gaps: Initial boundary, missing overlap anchor, changed agent Pod/container/restart count, disconnection over five minutes, malformed/oversized reads, ingestion failures and heartbeat expiry. Gaps stay explicit; no claim of lossless kubelet logs or detector liveness.

joinedInputs: fresh controller/Pod UID, generation, image and container inventory
assessmentReader.generationLimit: Existing records lack historical generation. A scan must start after the collector independently observed the current UID/generation/digest epoch. Old history remains unknown rather than inheriting current coverage generation.
assessmentReader.completeness: Per-enrolled Deployment/container only; all current replicas ready with one running digest, current UID/generation and Pod set, healthy overall latest batch and per-record attempt/coverage, retained terminal success and verified locked database. Missing/excluded/unsupported/failed/stale are explicit and preserve qualified findings.
